column8: Observed edge mutation selects ObservedEdgeUpdater exactly on the original engine via OwnedCapability and otherwise calls that engine's ordinary UpdateEdge. An executed error is returned without retry.

Observed node mutation selects ObservedNodeUpdater exactly on the original engine via OwnedCapability and otherwise invokes that same engine's UpdateNode. No child walk or refusal replay is permitted.
